headline_seed: Kenyan leader sparks uproar after mocking Nigerians' spoken English
description_seed: William Ruto says Kenyans speak "some of the best English in the world" while it is hard to understand Nigerians.

what: Kenyan leader sparks uproar after mocking Nigerians' spoken English

clean_source_blocks.text: William Ruto says Kenyans speak "some of the best English in the world" while it is hard to understand Nigerians.
Kenyan President William Ruto has faced a social media backlash after publicly suggesting that Nigerian-accented English was incomprehensible and required a translator.
But in his address to the diaspora gathering, Ruto said Kenya's education system produced strong English proficiency and that it was difficult to understand Nigerians when they spoke English.
His remarks drew fierce condemnation from Nigerians and other Africans online who accused the Kenyan leader of demeaning a fellow African nation.

source_text:
William Ruto says Kenyans speak "some of the best English in the world" while it is hard to understand Nigerians.

Kenyan President William Ruto has faced a social media backlash after publicly suggesting that Nigerian-accented English was incomprehensible and required a translator.

But in his address to the diaspora gathering, Ruto said Kenya's education system produced strong English proficiency and that it was difficult to understand Nigerians when they spoke English.

His remarks drew fierce condemnation from Nigerians and other Africans online who accused the Kenyan leader of demeaning a fellow African nation.
